note: Deaf Smith County (TX) publishes no queryable zoning district layer. Texas counties generally do not zone; the county's appraisal district (deafsmithcad.org) offers only a parcel map. The City of Hereford, the county's only zoning jurisdiction found, publishes its Zoning Ordinance as a PDF (DocumentCenter/View/199), and its Chapter 14 is kept as a separate document on file with the city secretary. Its Building & Zoning page links no GIS or map service. ArcGIS Online and Hub searches for zoning in Deaf Smith/Hereford returned nothing relevant. No official zoning polygons are queryable.
